title: Verify: BootScene.preload loads only planned assets
description: Test BootScene.preload with mocked Phaser load and mocked content.

steps.symbol: new: BootScene preload plans only scene assets
steps.action: Mock phaser like bootScene.test.ts; vi.mock '../src/runtime/content' to export a scene with objects referencing 'objects/bed' and 'objects/ghost' and a manifest holding 'objects/bed' and unused 'objects/desk'. Set boot.load = { image: vi.fn() }, spy console.warn, call boot.preload(). Assert image called once with ('objects/bed','assets/<path>'), never with 'objects/desk' or 'objects/ghost', and warn called with a message containing 'objects/ghost'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootScenePreload.test.ts
